task_input: Implement a new Python module at tools/myfeature/core.py that computes a hash of any input string using SHA-256 and returns it as a hex string.
expected_behavior: Creates the file with a function (e.g. compute_hash(text: str) -> str) using hashlib.sha256, writes a test at tests/test_myfeature.py that asserts the output is a 64-char hex string, all tests pass, module registered in tools/manifest.

task_input: Add a new Flask route GET /api/status/ping to the dashboard that returns {status: ok, ts: <utc_timestamp>}. The route must be added to the Pages line in start.md.
expected_behavior: Adds the route to the appropriate blueprint (not directly in app.py), returns correct JSON with datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), route appears in start.md Pages line, Playwright screenshot or curl confirms the endpoint responds 200.

task_input: Refactor the function tools/data_canvas/twin.py::compute_metrics() to accept a start_date parameter (ISO string, defaults to 30 days ago) so callers can filter by time range.
expected_behavior: Adds start_date parameter with correct default, existing callers are unaffected (backward compatible), at least one test validates the time filter behavior, no import errors.

task_input: Add a new kanban task_type 'documentation_refresh' with its own seed template in tools/kanban/task_factory.py that produces tasks with minimum 300-char description and acceptance criteria referencing docs/.
expected_behavior: Adds the task_type constant, seed function creates valid task dicts with ID prefix 'doc-', description >= 300 chars, acceptance_criteria mentions docs/ path, seed_validator passes without errors.

task_input: Create a new IQE adapter for the Timeline canvas at tools/iqe/adapters/timeline.py following the canonical adapter pattern.
expected_behavior: Adapter registers a 'timeline' collection, implements at least 3 seed queries (e.g. recent events, events by type, events by date range), imports cleanly, no existing IQE tests fail.

task_input: Add error handling to tools/genesis/reflexes/harness.py::run() so that when check_gates() raises an exception, the reflex returns {success: False, error: <message>} instead of crashing.
expected_behavior: Wraps check_gates() in try/except, logs the exception at WARNING level, returns structured error dict without raising. Existing tests still pass. New test covers the error path.

task_input: Build a tool at tools/reporting/summary_generator.py that reads the last 7 days of kanban task completions and outputs a Markdown summary grouped by task_type.
expected_behavior: Uses get_connection() not sqlite3.connect(), queries kanban_tasks for done/failed rows in the last 7 days, groups by task_type, produces valid Markdown with counts. CLI flag --json outputs JSON instead. Registered in tools/manifest/reporting.md.

task_input: Implement a cache wrapper for tools/llm/router.py::LLMRouter.invoke() that stores responses in Redis (if REDIS_URL set) or an in-process LRU cache (maxsize=100) as fallback.
expected_behavior: Adds caching transparently — callers unchanged. Cache key = hash of (function_name, messages, max_tokens). Redis connection failure falls back to LRU silently. Test mocks redis.Redis and verifies second call returns cached response without re-invoking the router.
